description: SE423 final roadmap: how principles, organization, people, stakeholders, development approach, planning and control fit together (no Scheduling and tracking or Quality on the final), with the material to study for every topic, look-alike terms side by side and a coverage tracker.
lede: SE423 follows a project's life: the principles that guide every decision, the organization, people and stakeholders around the project (and how you communicate with them), the development approach you choose, how you plan it (risk, estimation), and how you keep it under control (change). Not on the final: Chapter 6.2 (Scheduling and tracking) and Chapter 7 (Quality), so planning stops at estimation and control is change management only. Your instructor marks the why and how, so each topic links to material that explains them.
